description:
Grafana Assistant brings a purpose-built LLM to Grafana so operators, developers, and SREs can troubleshoot issues, manage dashboards, and answer product questions in minutes. 

Whether you’re analyzing data, polishing dashboards for executives, or guiding teammates to navigation and knowledge resources, Assistant removes manual querying and helps teams move faster. 

Organizations save hours of toil and reduce operational cost by letting Assistant surface insights while engineers focus on higher-value work.

defaultPrompt: Ask Grafana Assistant why checkout latency is spiking right now.
Investigate errors from the latest deployment.
Summarize active incidents and related alerts.
